Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The design and custody decisions have led to landed S0-S9/S11 code. The original design-only body no longer identifies the next implementation step. S10 entry point, production ScoreFeed, owner reader, freeze and custody rehearsal remain deferred explicitly.

Fresh context: Yes: design delivered / S10 handoff.

Next action: Resume from docs/plans/phrf-pilot-runner-design.md and sealed-format/runbook, with owner-key and commit-reveal custody. Keep raw pilot data sealed and run only synthetic rehearsal until campaign prerequisites/decisions are satisfied.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/plans/phrf-pilot-sealed-format.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Pilot-scoped (owner D1). Design how the Scala side ingests generator datasets (schema tools/phrf-comparison/generator/SCHEMA.md), invokes PHRF (condition and trial ML paths at the bound source), CAN/INF3/FIR, LSA/LSS/rLSS and the GLMsingle wrapper on the 7 pilot cells. Define the output: only variance components of centred differences, ICCs, pooled refusal rates and timings, never comparative results. Define custody: beacon-A root and a non-author custodian (default backlog-worker-20260930). Deliverable: a design doc and Mote slice list; no implementation.
